# Patches to the vendored OpenSKP (third_party/openskp)

The subset is the parser only: the model, the VFF and MFC containers, the TLV and
page/dimension decoding, the transforms, and miniz. Two files are patched; each patch is a
standalone file in `patches/`, applied by `scripts/vendor-openskp.py`, and must apply cleanly
to the pinned commit.

## src/parser.cpp — drop the scene-builder wrappers

The patch file is `patches/parser.cpp.patch`.

Upstream's `parser.cpp` defines `SkpFile::build_scene`, `SkpFile::build_instanced_scene`,
`build_scene` and `build_instanced_scene`; their bodies call `build_scene_raw` and
`build_instanced_scene_raw`, which live in `scene.cpp` and `instanced_scene.cpp` - the scene
baker, which the subset excludes. A link that needed them would fail; nothing in the subset
calls them. The patch deletes the four definitions; the declarations in `parser.hpp` stay
(they are declared-but-undefined only if a caller asks for them, which the helper does not).

```diff
--- a/src/parser.cpp
+++ b/src/parser.cpp
@@ ... @@
-SkpFile SkpFile::build_scene(const ParseOptions& o) const { return openskp::build_scene(data_, o); }
-
-InstancedScene SkpFile::build_instanced_scene(const ParseOptions& o) const {
-  return openskp::build_instanced_scene(data_, o);
-}
-
 SkpModel parse_skp(ByteBuffer b, const ParseOptions& o) { return build_model(full_parse(b, o), o); }
-
-Scene build_scene(ByteBuffer b, const ParseOptions& o) {
-  return build_scene_raw(full_parse(b, o), o);
-}
-
-InstancedScene build_instanced_scene(ByteBuffer b, const ParseOptions& o) {
-  return build_instanced_scene_raw(full_parse(b, o), o);
-}
```

## src/internal.hpp — include the public headers it uses, not the umbrella

The patch file is `patches/internal.hpp.patch`.

Upstream's `internal.hpp` includes `openskp/openskp.hpp`, the umbrella that includes every
public header, exporters included; the exporters are the only headers that need tinygltf and
flatbuffers. The subset replaces the umbrella with the headers the sources actually use:

```diff
--- a/src/internal.hpp
+++ b/src/internal.hpp
@@ ... @@
-#include <openskp/openskp.hpp>
+#include <openskp/errors.hpp>
+#include <openskp/instanced_scene.hpp>
+#include <openskp/model.hpp>
+#include <openskp/observability.hpp>
+#include <openskp/parser.hpp>
+#include <openskp/scene.hpp>
```

The scene and instanced-scene headers are declarations only; their implementations are the
excluded `scene.cpp` and `instanced_scene.cpp`, so including the headers drags in nothing.
`export.hpp` (generated by CMake's `generate_export_header`, as upstream does) defines
`OPENSKP_EXPORT`; with `OPENSKP_STATIC_DEFINE` it is empty, as in upstream's static build.

## Moving the pin

Re-run `scripts/vendor-openskp.py update <dir>` from the new commit archives; re-prove the
subset compiles and `parse_skp` links, and re-run the corpus before moving.
